danger.$description: Danger secondary & ghost button label and border. DO NOT change dark back to Figma's red.45: it is red.40 on purpose. Measured on dark background-primary / layer-1 / layer-2, red.40 gives 5.84 / 5.53 / 4.76:1; red.45 gives 5.10 / 4.84 / 4.16:1 and fails AA on layer-2. Open issue: light red.55 fails AA on layer-1 (4.35:1) and layer-3 (3.99:1); red.60 would clear every light surface. Not changed without Emily's decision.
